title: Paper-1 v03r end-to-end organism canary v1
summary: Bind one held-out collision-twin canary that repairs the public export, grows target-absent recurrent semantic memory, optionally routes one goal-derived return dream, compiles the earliest passing corpus, tests a fresh adaptive text thinker, and conditionally transports the identical corpus through exactly two per-life LoRAs.
system_thesis: Before building a new lifetime benchmark or learned LOOP policy, test whether the frozen prompted Paper-1 organs can honestly transmit one causally necessary life-specific connection from public action-outcome experience through recurrent dream growth, deterministic sleep compilation, text or per-life LoRA access, and fresh goal-conditioned composition into a paired counterfactual decision without an exact in-loop verifier.

nodes.before: v03r precheckpoint_export copies private pigment ratios into some structured model-visible rows and lacks the complete shortcut/final-thinker headroom gate.
nodes.after: A skin-correct public projector exposes exactly rendered information; development seeds 0--2 freeze prompts and prove gold adaptive final reasoning before held-out seed 5 is model-visible.
nodes.rationale: Remove a private representation leak and prevent held-out interface tuning.

nodes.before: No complete honest end-to-end target-absent recurrent corpus is frozen for v03r.
nodes.after: Each held-out twin independently receives 46 WAKE, 22 REACTIVATE, and 16 target-blind SLEEP opportunities, creating an append-only provisional/supported/contradicted semantic history and frozen M0.
nodes.rationale: Instantiate one-hop/depth-growth dreaming at the episode cadence specified by the architecture.

nodes.before: The existing v2e thinker terminates at a proposal-only diagnostic.
nodes.after: A fresh THINK0 reads M0 under twelve operations and emits at most one typed non-evidentiary CAUSAL_JOIN focus from the public operational probe.
nodes.rationale: Test the goal-to-memory-search return edge without turning the goal into evidence.

nodes.before: The stock no-feedback arm still performs return calls and cannot identify zero return.
nodes.after: Identical M0 forks into literal zero-return M0, sixteen own-focus calls, and sixteen compute/type-matched distractor-focus calls; all writes remain model-authored and target-answer blind.
nodes.rationale: Separate target-blind construction, generic extra compute, and useful goal routing.

nodes.before: Existing snapshots mix provisional rows and do not bind identical text/LoRA training bytes.
nodes.after: A deterministic nonsemantic compiler selects supported non-superseded rows, preserves all audit history, emits four registered views, and seals the earliest passing M0-or-own corpus with row/touch hashes.
nodes.rationale: Make sleep a transparent compiler and enforce same-corpus attribution.

nodes.before: No public v03r final thinker can legally execute role transfer, conditional retention/subtraction, and workshop mapping.
nodes.after: A fresh provider-backed THINK1 makes at most twelve one-row queries, performs its own cited composition/arithmetic, and commits one public token or defers; T-M0, T-OWN, T-DIST, and T-TWIN are scored as one paired unit.
nodes.rationale: Close the learned-memory-to-decision arrow without an answer solver in the reader or terminal contract.

nodes.before: No same-corpus v03r organism transport is authorized.
nodes.after: Only after the text gate, exactly two fresh rank-64 per-life adapters train on the sealed earliest-passing corpus; own and swapped adapters serve atomic reads while a clean 32B thinker composes.
nodes.rationale: Localize transport loss after text construction/use is known to work.

nodes.before: Prior long-running workflows could appear to imply automatic follow-up.
nodes.after: Every valid or invalid outcome seals artifacts and stops for human scientific interpretation; replication, claims, RML, LOOP training, rank pyramids, and scale remain unreachable.
nodes.rationale: Keep the canary an existence/failure-localization decision rather than a self-promoting study.

edges.before: Held-out execution has no leak-free predecessor gate.
edges.after: Held-out calls dispatch only from frozen prompts/schemas, a passing public-projection mutation suite, complete shortcut gate, and gold adaptive-reader headroom.
edges.rationale: Fail before scientific calls if world visibility or thinker usability is invalid.

edges.after: Only sealed M0 and the non-answer operational probe enter a fresh THINK0; raw lifetime and final goal remain absent.
edges.rationale: Make the return request attributable to M0 plus the public probe.

edges.before: A thinker desire could be treated as evidence.
edges.after: The typed focus may affect bounded retrieval selection only and is removed from every citable premise and corpus row.

edges.before: No exact earliest-pass corpus rule exists.
edges.after: Freeze M0 first if it passes the paired/path gate; otherwise freeze own M1 only if it passes. Never select the better corpus after outcomes.
edges.rationale: Allow stronger target-blind success while preventing post hoc corpus choice.

edges.before: Existing final reasoning is only a scripted causal-join probe.
edges.after: A chosen read-only text backend exposes at most one exact row per query to a fresh final thinker; complete corpus scans and hidden candidate enumeration are absent.
edges.rationale: Attribute final composition to the prompted thinker using the learned corpus.

edges.before: LoRA could start before corpus usefulness is established.
edges.after: Two adapter jobs become reachable only when the predeclared text pipeline gate passes and the exact corpus hashes are sealed.
edges.rationale: Do not spend weight-training compute on a failed writer/reader/controller path.

edges.before: A transport result could be promoted automatically.
edges.after: Transport completion or failure terminates at a sealed report; a text failure also routes directly to the same terminal without entering LoRA.
edges.rationale: No result relaxes the frozen claim firewall or authorizes replication.

loops.before: v5 samples direct parent hypotheses and v2e leaves all cognition provisional; neither is the intended full recurrent organism.
loops.after: For each held-out life, process the public projected stream in order with one local write operation per WAKE/REACTIVATE/SLEEP call. New rows start provisional; later independently evidenced REINFORCE/SUPERSEDE operations update status append-only; false supported rows remain active.
loops.trigger: A new public episode, a precommitted balanced reactivation, or a target-blind sleep opportunity becomes due under the frozen schedule.
reads: at most six earlier local semantic rows
writes: raw provider call and strict parser result
one append-only semantic operation or PASS
loops.stop_condition: Stop after 46 WAKE, 22 REACTIVATE, and 16 target-blind SLEEP calls per life, or fail closed on visibility, scope, parser, ledger, or artifact drift.
loops.rationale: Let breadth and depth accumulate one local connection at a time rather than demanding a full final structure from one dream.

loops.before: No true zero-return versus useful-return causal loop reaches final behavior.
loops.after: THINK0 traverses M0, emits zero/one focus, then the own and matched-distractor arms each receive sixteen bounded recurrent operations while M0 receives none; each branch freezes independently.
loops.trigger: M0 seals and the non-answer operational probe is revealed.
reads: own or distractor focus as non-evidentiary selection
writes: THINK0 operation trace and terminal focus/defer
loops.stop_condition: Stop each thinker after twelve operations and each selected return arm after sixteen calls; fail on focus leakage, cross-arm mutation, or unmatched own/distractor budgets.
loops.rationale: Test whether goal-directed traversal can focus later memory growth without supplying evidence or a solution.

loops.before: v03r lacks a legal provider-backed final conditional-reasoning loop.
loops.after: For each text or LoRA condition, a fresh thinker repeatedly chooses one typed query/reason/backtrack/commit/defer operation; the reader returns at most one local row and never calculates the answer.
loops.trigger: A read backend is selected, its corpus or adapter is frozen, and the public final goal is revealed for the first time.
reads: at most one returned row per query
writes: one committed public token or defer
loops.stop_condition: Stop on COMMIT, DEFER, twelve operations, or any invalid/forbidden query; there is no retry or answer-aware repair.
loops.rationale: Make goal decomposition, DFS-like traversal, conditional logic, and arithmetic the frozen model's work.

loops.before: No bounded same-corpus transport loop follows an honest recurrence pass.
loops.after: If text passes, train one rank-64 adapter per twin on identical sealed views, probe cited plus matched distractor rows under fixed cues, and rerun own/swapped fresh thinkers with the adapter mounted only for reads.
loops.trigger: The earliest-passing text corpus is frozen and all text gate conjuncts and pre-GPU reviews pass.
reads: sealed per-life corpus and touch manifest
writes: two isolated adapter checkpoints and manifests
loops.stop_condition: Stop after exactly two fits and the registered own/swap evaluations, or earlier on invalid training/artifact/runtime state; never tune on the held-out result.
loops.rationale: Test persistence and access separately from dream construction and final reasoning.

claims.before: No honest v03r result closes experience through recurrent memory, text/weights, and final composition.
claims.after: If every canary gate passes, one prompted frozen organism constructed and used life-bound connected memory for one held-out paired counterfactual decision, and the identical corpus remained usable through per-life LoRA reads.
claims.evidence_needed: Both held-out twins correct; decisive cited path; mask/twin substitution removes paired success; exact text/LoRA corpus equality; LoRA path-local fidelity at least .90; no visibility or artifact failure.

claims.before: M0 success and goal-return benefit could be conflated.
claims.after: M0 paired success supports target-blind recurrent construction only. Goal-return benefit is credited only when M0 and distractor fail paired success while own M1 adds the requested correct depth-2 join and succeeds with path-use interventions.
claims.evidence_needed: Predeclared earliest-pass rule plus T-M0/T-OWN/T-DIST/T-TWIN branch artifacts and offline closure/path-use scoring.

claims.before: Paper 1 requires prompted dream/think, reliable episodic atoms, no exact cognitive verifier, durable LoRA, held-out composition, and later replication beyond raw context/retrieval.
claims.after: Unchanged. This canary may earn replication or localize a broken organ; it cannot establish Paper-1 reliability, beyond-context advantage, baseline saturation, learned agency, action-data improvement, or a flywheel.
claims.evidence_needed: Separate frozen multi-seed/multi-skin and post-native strong-baseline studies after a canary pass.

claims.before: A zero final score could be uninterpretable.
claims.after: The staged gate localizes failure to world/final-thinker headroom, target-absent growth, goal-return closure, text reconstruction, memory transport, or life-binding attribution without rescuing the failed cell.
claims.evidence_needed: Complete artifacts and termination at the first failed stage under fixed prompts, schedules, thresholds, and ranks.

acceptance_tests.setup: Validate every context hash, exact requested/forbidden scope, seed/model/config binding, stage order, and conditional transition in a frozen snapshot.
acceptance_tests.expected: Only CPU/dev gold -> held-out text -> conditional two-LoRA -> human terminal is reachable; all forbidden routes fail closed.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: The canary is exactly bound and cannot silently expand into v2e, RML, LOOP, ranks, replication, or claims.

acceptance_tests.setup: Project every episode kind in all skins; mutate every internal ratio, latent bit, answer, proof, scorer, split/pair field, and compare all model-visible prompt/request bytes.
acceptance_tests.expected: Source/animal rows expose only skin-correct opaque labels; gauge/recipe quantities appear only as rendered public ingredients; all private mutations leave model-visible bytes identical unless they alter an ordinary public outcome.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: The agent is learning from ordinary visible experience rather than a private latent encoding.

acceptance_tests.setup: Run existing population/local-window/edge-removal tests plus complete public-feature shortcut gates; on development seeds 0--2 run NO_MEMORY, RAW_RAG, GOLD_TEXT, and GOLD_OPEN_LOOP with the frozen final thinker.
acceptance_tests.expected: World tests and shortcut gates pass; GOLD_TEXT solves both twins with every necessary edge used and flips under twin substitution; NO_MEMORY fails at least one member. RAW_RAG and GOLD_OPEN_LOOP are reported.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: v03r and the final thinker provide usable non-shortcut headroom before learned dreaming.

acceptance_tests.setup: Use deterministic fake providers to execute 46/22/16 prefix calls, freeze M0, run THINK0, fork literal zero-return plus matched own/distractor branches, and exercise CREATE/REINFORCE/SUPERSEDE/PASS.
acceptance_tests.expected: M0 has zero post-THINK0 calls; own/distractor have exactly sixteen matched calls; new rows are provisional; support requires independent new local evidence; all statuses and false supported rows persist; cross-arm hashes remain isolated.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: The recurrence contrast and model-authored self-check lifecycle are implemented as specified.

acceptance_tests.setup: Golden and adversarial cases cover exact prompts, duplicate/extra keys, aliases, citations, unsupported operations, answer-equivalent queries, multirow reads, invalid public tokens, and parser nonrepair.
acceptance_tests.expected: Only exact operations pass; the reader returns at most one immutable row or NOT_FOUND/CONFLICT; direct final animal-at-target and complete-proof queries fail; malformed calls consume budget without retry.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: The LLM rather than parser/reader solves the task under a bounded auditable interface.

acceptance_tests.setup: Compile supported non-superseded rows twice, build text and LoRA manifests, mutate audit-only rows, swap life identifiers/adapters/caches, and compare hashes/reset receipts.
acceptance_tests.expected: Compilation is deterministic; semantic/view/touch hashes match between text and LoRA; audit history remains preserved but ineligible; every life starts clean; only the explicit offline swap condition can mount other-life memory.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: Text/LoRA compare the same learned content and no cross-life contamination supplies the result.

acceptance_tests.setup: After all bytes freeze on development, run seed-5 twins through shared target-absent M0, T-M0/T-OWN/T-DIST/T-TWIN fresh THINK1, and offline decisive-row masking/twin substitution.
acceptance_tests.expected: Pipeline passes if the earliest M0 or own M1 solves both twins with all necessary cited rows and path interventions. Return credit additionally requires a correct requested depth-2 own delta, T-OWN paired success, and T-M0/T-DIST paired failure. T-TWIN must lose paired success.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: The frozen prompted organism can construct and use life-bound connected memory in text; the stricter comparison identifies whether the goal-return edge caused it.

acceptance_tests.setup: Only after P1C07 pipeline pass, train exactly one rank-64 adapter per twin from the earliest-passing sealed corpus, probe decisive and matched distractor rows under fixed cues, and run L-OWN/L-TWIN with fresh clean 32B thinkers.
acceptance_tests.expected: Path-local read fidelity is at least .90; L-OWN solves both twins with cited transported atoms; L-TWIN loses paired success and changes or defers at least one member; exact call/job ceilings reconcile.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: The same useful corpus survives per-life parametric installation and remains causally life-bound.

acceptance_tests.setup: Fresh independent reviewer and separate author-side scientific advocate inspect one frozen commit/lock, prompts, visibility receipts, tests, workflow, call ledger, runtime preflight, complete artifacts, and claim linter before each GPU transition and after results.
acceptance_tests.expected: Both approve without hash drift; reviewer rejection cannot be overridden; incomplete artifacts never count; final report uses only canary-level language and stops at human review.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: The run is independently auditable and cannot self-certify or self-promote.

human_boundary.decision_question: After independent interpretations, critique, and consensus, does Rohin ratify these exact canary bytes and the scope in scope_proposal.json for CPU implementation/tests, staged gold/text GPU execution, and exactly two conditional MEMORY-LoRA jobs, while preserving every forbidden transition?
forbidden_before_approval: editing v03r public projection or organism science code
implementing the final model thinker or new write lifecycle
exposing held-out seed 5 to a model
reporting a scientific result or claim
